Title: Improving Azure App Service Node.js and PHP developer experience with Linux support

Body.Content: In March 2015, Azure App Service became generally available, making it easier for web developers to do cool things in the cloud. In addition to a great experience for .NET developers, App Service supports PHP, Node.js, Java, and Python stacks, as well as a number of open-source web products. A new public preview introduces native Linux support for Node.js and PHP stacks.
